description:
PearCal is a peer-to-peer calendar app that syncs directly between devices — no server, no cloud, no accounts required.

Your calendar data never leaves your group. It lives only on the devices of the people you choose to share with, powered by Hypercore Protocol.

FEATURES

Peer Groups

Create a group and invite others via a share link or QR code. Each group has its own color and avatar. Members see only the events shared with them.

Events & Reminders

Create one-time or recurring events. Set a reminder time per event. Selectively share events with specific group members — not everyone in a group has to see every event.

Holidays
Optional US, Canada, and UK public holiday calendars. Toggle per country from your profile. Holiday events are read-only and stored locally only.

Privacy First

No account creation. No email address. No tracking. No ads. Your data stays on your devices.

Open Source
PearCal is free and open source. Source code is available on GitHub.

PERMISSIONS

Camera — used to set your profile photo and scan QR invite codes.
Photo Library — used to set your profile photo.
whatsNew:
New Features
  - Personal calendars: keep separate calendars like Work, Health or Family, each with its own name and color. They sync to your other linked devices.
  - Show or hide any calendar: tap the new Calendars button to switch personal calendars, holiday countries and groups on or off. Each device remembers its own choices, and reminders still go off for hidden calendars.
  - Web calendars: paste a calendar link (https:// or webcal://), such as your country's public holidays, and PearCal keeps it up to date. These events are read-only and never shared with your groups.
  - Import into any calendar: when you import an .ics file, choose which personal calendar it goes into, or create a new one named after the file.

Improvements
  - Desktop: personal and web calendars now appear above Groups in the sidebar, and you can fold the Groups list away.
  - Desktop: your choices for which calendars to show are now remembered after you close the app.
  - Automatic export can now save each personal calendar to its own file.

Privacy
  - The Android app no longer includes any Google Play Services code.
